text: What actually pops when you crack your knuckles? Not your bones. Your joints sit in a capsule of fluid. Pull the joint apart, the pressure drops, and a gas cavity snaps open. In 2015, scientists filmed it inside an MRI. The pop happened as the bubble formed. A 2018 model says a partial collapse could still make the sound. The debate isn't over. And arthritis? A study of 215 people found no link. So it's just a bubble. Do you crack yours?
